VIDEO_VIEWS.reason: deferred — video-completion metrics (VIDEO_25_PERCENTILE_VIEWS, VIDEO_50_PERCENTILE_VIEWS, VIDEO_75_PERCENTILE_VIEWS, VIDEO_100_PERCENTILE_VIEWS, VIDEO_TOTAL_VIEWS) require a video-creative entity type not in scope for the initial v12 catalog. Will be added when a video-specific profile is introduced.

MEDIA_VIEWS.reason: deferred — MEDIA_VIEWS and MEDIA_ENGAGEMENTS are sub-groupings of video/GIF placements and share the same entity-type prerequisite as VIDEO_VIEWS. Excluded alongside VIDEO_VIEWS for scope consistency.

WEB_CONVERSIONS.reason: deferred — WEB_CONVERSIONS sub-metrics (app installs, site visits, add-to-cart, purchase, sign-up) require the advertiser to have a Website Tag or App SDK installed and events configured. The generic CONVERSIONS field (included) covers the aggregate. Fine-grained web conversion metrics will be added when the conversion-tracking profile is introduced.

MOBILE_CONVERSION.reason: deferred — MOBILE_CONVERSION_* metrics (installs, re-engagements, add-to-cart, etc.) require a mobile app measurement partner (MMP) integration. No MMP scope is in the current story. Excluded until an app-attribution profile is introduced.

CARD_ENGAGEMENTS.reason: deferred — card-specific engagement metrics (URL_CLICKS_FOR_CARD, CARD_LIKES, CARD_RETWEETS) are only available for card-creative line items. No card-creative entity type is in scope for v1. Excluded until a card-creative profile is added.

PROMOTED_TWEET_FULL_ENTITY_ANALYTICS.reason: deferred — PROMOTED_TWEET is currently exposed as a dimension only (promoted_tweet_id in promoted_post_daily profile). Full entity-level analytics for promoted tweets with all metric groups would require a dedicated entity analytics path. Deferred pending promoted-tweet analytics profile story.
